followup_rules: Do not fill a missing signature centerpiece with unrelated furniture solely to obtain item counts.
Create individually transparent PNGs, add metadata, and only then place new asset IDs.
Do not modify character PNGs or gameplay movement.
Do not approve a room until all critical visual features are represented and a new Godot preview has been compared with the user reference.

goal_0001_spec_audit.match_rule: A 'mapped' item uses an asset whose name directly names the spec item. Any doubt about pattern, material, animation or orientation is listed as a gap; no unrelated substitutes.
goal_0001_spec_audit.asset_status_note: Mapped assets are mostly status needs_cleanup and still require artist/visual QA; mapping is not visual approval.
